Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files and exfiltrating data for extortion with threat of publishing stolen files unless ransom is paid
Impacted Systems: Southwire wire and cable manufacturer computers
Attack Vector: Infection of computers leading to encryption and data exfiltration
Ransom demand with threat of data leak
Ransomware attack encrypting devices and stealing data
Indicators of Compromise: Data leaks of 14.1GB and 10GB from Southwire
Ransom demands in bitcoins (e.g., 200 BTC, 850 BTC)
Public posting of stolen data on forums and websites
